name: std/crypto
description: Declares cryptography and secure random operations.
readme: Declares cryptography and secure random operations.
Import this module with use crypto.

files.content:
-- Declares cryptography and secure random operations.
public use "crypto" function hash(value text) giving failable text.
public use "crypto" function random(size unsigned 32) giving failable text.
public use "crypto" function seal(value text, secret text, nonce text, extra text) giving failable text.
public use "crypto" function open(value text, secret text, nonce text, extra text) giving failable text.
public use "crypto" function key(seed text) giving failable text.
public use "crypto" function sign(value text, seed text) giving failable text.
public use "crypto" function verify(value text, signature text, signer text) giving boolean.
public use "crypto" function password(value text) giving failable text.
public use "crypto" function confirm(value text, encoded text) giving failable boolean.
